design.identification: fixed five-class logistic leave-one-patch-out; class recall
design.interpretation: pairwise BA is an estimate, not a significance claim or independent reference validation
design.predictive_discriminability: fixed pairwise logistic leave-one-patch-out; balanced accuracy, chance50%
design.preprocessing: training-only StandardScaler; balanced logistic C1; no tuning
design.primary_cohort: nominal HLS footprint >=95% mapped cover; restored original reference definition
design.randomization: fixed input-derived seed per comparison; within-region labels preserved for region-conditioned tests
design.reflectance: B1–B7 direct NBAR; no plot normalization
design.selection: no rejection of references by spectral fit or test outcome; all reviewed passes retained
design.sensitivity: full 4x4 native source-area >=95%; extra conservative diagnostic
design.sequential_collection: exploratory expanded cohort; current Holm family does not adjust across prior collection/analysis rounds
design.statistical_separation: patch-level max/integrated NPC; exact <=100000 assignments, otherwise observed+99999 random labels; Holm family10
